seoTitle: How to Create a Customer Database with Google Forms
metaDescription: Build a free CRM using Google Forms and Google Sheets by linking a client intake form to a spreadsheet database with email alerts.
intro: You don't need paid CRM software to keep track of customer contact details when Google Forms and Google Sheets can handle the job for free. This guide covers designing a client intake form, linking it to a spreadsheet database, and setting up notifications so you never miss a new submission.

steps.heading: Design your intake form
steps.body: Create a new form in Google Forms with a clean, professional layout for collecting customer information.

steps.heading: Add key data fields
steps.body: Include mandatory fields like name, contact info, and any relevant notes.

steps.heading: Customize form design and branding
steps.body: Adjust the form's colors and styling to match your business branding.

steps.heading: Link the form to a Google Sheet
steps.body: Connect your form responses directly to a new Google Sheets file to serve as your database.

steps.heading: Structure the response database
steps.body: Organize the columns in your response spreadsheet for easy filtering and sorting.

steps.heading: Enable email notifications
steps.body: Turn on automated email alerts for new submissions, then run a test entry to confirm everything works.

faq.question: Is this really a free alternative to a CRM?
faq.answer: Yes, using Google Forms linked to Google Sheets gives you a no-cost way to collect and organize customer contact details.

faq.question: Can I get notified when someone submits the form?
faq.answer: Yes, you can enable automated email alerts so you're notified immediately when a new customer entry comes in.

faq.question: Can I filter and sort the customer data easily?
faq.answer: Yes, structuring your response spreadsheet with clear columns makes it straightforward to filter and sort customer rows.

faq.question: Is this suitable for a growing business, or just a quick fix?
faq.answer: It works well for small businesses, freelancers, and service providers who need a simple, reliable system without the overhead of dedicated CRM software.
